article.story: AUBURN HILLS, Mich. -- — Allen Mukeba scored 22 points and grabbed 11 rebounds, Tuburu Niavalurua also scored 22 points and Oakland beat Purdue Fort Wayne 76-72 on Wednesday night. Niavalurua added eight rebounds for the Golden Grizzlies (9-12, 6-4 Horizon League). Jaylen Jones finished with 12 points. Jalen Jackson led the way for the Mastodons (14-7, 7-3) with 17 points. Chandler Cuthrell added 13 points and seven rebounds for Purdue Fort Wayne. Quinton Morton-Robertson also recorded 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
